Gallery Trail

  • Three different prints
1→2→3
  1. Each player solves the same sequence of three different prints.
  2. Match each print's last note to the next print's opening note.
  3. Keep chaining until all three prints are linked.

Encore Duet

  • Plain sticks
  1. Both players use plain sticks on the last frame to start the duet.
  2. Then take turns tapping the marked frames.

Coda Postcards

  • Plain glow ink
  • Plain paper
  1. After completing the duet, each player taps a score with plain glow ink.
  2. Tap normally to pick its closing note, or Sneak and tap to pick its opening note.
  3. After both players have picked, either one can stamp plain paper on the last frame.

Note blocks and chimes are covered in the full exploration guide on the hub.
